label: preparing
what: Coordinated bread supplies and hospitality for an evening gathering in the great hall, with the mayor scheduled to arrive at 18:00 and not early. The preparations initially proceeded without the mayor being told their purpose; the mayor was subsequently told about deliveries and a hospitality committee, but the gathering's actual agenda remains unestablished. Baker and neighbour knowingly helped with bread, without demonstrated knowledge of any concealed purpose. No reliable evidence establishes a surprise celebration or a bridge/port project; secretary appears to arrange the approved appointment and investigate, not knowingly conceal the preparations.
